I need to decide on a ranking methodology. Since no weighting is provided, I should note that but still make a recommendation based on typical priorities: energy and water efficiency are usually top, then noise, then cycle time.

The Siemens SX87EX01CE (IDX-SIEMENS-SX87EX01CE) has the best energy consumption (0.49 kWh), tied best water (9.0L), good noise (42 dB), but longest cycle (295 min).

The three models at 0.54 kWh, 9.0L, 40 dB, 295 min are slightly worse on energy but better on noise.

EPREL-1806358 has much shorter cycle (215 min) but higher energy (0.645).

Given typical EU energy label priorities, energy efficiency is paramount. The Siemens SX87EX01CE has the lowest energy per cycle. It also has low water consumption. Noise is 42 vs 40 for some others. Cycle time is longest.

But the three Bosch/Siemens models with 0.54/9.0/40/295 are very similar. The Siemens SX87EX01CE beats them on energy (0.49 vs 0.54).

So IDX-SIEMENS-SX87EX01CE seems best on the two most critical resources (energy, water), acceptable noise, but slowest.

I'll recommend that one.
